course.name: Medicine MBChB
course.notes: Graduate applicants may apply to A100 if Glasgow's published degree and recency requirements are met, but this is not a graduate-entry course.

applicant_pools.name: Scots domiciled / Home applicants
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: UCAT thresholds may vary by applicant group.
applicant_pools.notes: Future fixed quota is not published in the official evidence reviewed.

applicant_pools.name: Rest of UK applicants
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: UCAT thresholds may vary by applicant group.
applicant_pools.notes: Future fixed quota is not published in the official evidence reviewed.

applicant_pools.name: International / EU applicants
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: International applicants are ranked separately by UCAT cognitive total and compete only against other international applicants. The international threshold and interview quota are set for this pool.
applicant_pools.notes: Official historical statistics group International and EU together. No contextual uplift applies to international applicants, and no pre-published fixed UCAT threshold is stored.

applicant_pools.name: Graduate applicants
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Graduate applicants must meet Glasgow's degree and subject-recency rules and complete UCAT.
applicant_pools.notes: No separate graduate quota is published in the official evidence reviewed.

applicant_pools.name: Contextual / widening participation applicants
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Adjusted Scottish entry requirements and separate contextual UCAT shortlisting apply where official criteria are met.
applicant_pools.notes: Eligible Scottish-domiciled contextual applicants are ranked by unchanged raw UCAT in a separate group against a lower dynamic threshold.

overall_policy.description: Glasgow publishes 2027 A100 academic requirements, UCAT requirements, SJT policy, graduate applicant policy, resit policy and contextual Scottish adjusted requirements. Official UCAT-only ranking and historical applicant-group thresholds support medium-confidence interview guidance without a live cutoff; offer prediction remains unavailable.
not_eligible_if: Required academic criteria are not fulfilled.
UCAT is not sat by the required deadline in the year of application.
The applicant is screened out by non-academic suitability checks, personal statement or reference review.
Required grades and subjects are not obtained at one sitting and first attempt, unless Glasgow accepts documented extenuating circumstances.

grade_requirements.notes: Official evidence states GCSE English Literature or English Language at Grade B/6.
Official evidence states GCSE Biology at B/6 is required if Biology is not studied at A-level.

accepted_equivalencies.value: IGCSE English Literature or English Language at Grade B/6 is accepted where applicable.

gcse.notes: Official evidence reviewed does not publish a GCSE Mathematics requirement, a total GCSE count, or a top GCSE count for A100.

grade_requirements.notes: National 5 English at grade B or above.

national_5.notes: Required National 5 subjects are English, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics, each at grade B or above.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required alongside Chemistry.
International A-level applicants require Chemistry, Biology and one of Physics or Mathematics.

grade_requirements.notes: International A-level subject requirements are stricter than the UK A-level subject combination.

standard_offer.notes: A-level Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics for UK A-level applicants.

contextual_offer.notes: Official evidence reviewed only confirms adjusted Scottish requirements for Medicine, not an adjusted A-level offer.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: UK A-level applicants require Chemistry plus one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

third_subject_rules.policy: Any third A-level subject is accepted except the stated exclusions.

a_level.notes: Required grades and subjects must be obtained at one sitting and at first attempt.

grade_requirements.notes: HL Chemistry and Biology required; SL Physics or Mathematics at 6, with HL recommended; SL English at 6.

ib.notes: Official evidence also requires SL Physics or Mathematics at 6 and SL English at 6. These SL requirements are stored in notes because the current course template models HL requirements more directly than SL subject rules.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: BB at Advanced Higher in S6.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Higher Chemistry, Biology and Physics or Mathematics are required.

grade_requirements.notes: Higher Application of Mathematics cannot replace Higher Mathematics or Physics. Highers taken in S4 are not considered towards Higher S5 grade requirements.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: C grade cannot be in Chemistry. Successful completion of Reach is required.

grade_requirements.notes: Adjusted Scottish entry requirement for eligible widening participation applicants.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Higher Chemistry, Biology and Physics or Mathematics are required.

scottish.notes: Highers must meet S5 timing restrictions; required grades and subjects must be obtained at one sitting and at first attempt.

btec.notes: BTEC handling for A100 was not confirmed in the official evidence captured in the research file.

access_to_he.notes: Access to HE handling for A100 was not confirmed in the official evidence captured in the research file.

degree.notes: Minimum 2.1 Honours degree in a relevant science degree obtained within seven years of entry. Older relevant science degrees, non-science degrees and Masters/PhD compensation rules require the additional Chemistry/Biology evidence described in graduate_policy.

graduate_policy.standard: Minimum 2.1 Honours degree in a relevant science degree obtained within seven years of entry.
graduate_policy.older_or_non_science_degrees: Applicants whose degree is older than seven years or who have a non-science degree require A-level/Scottish Higher Chemistry and A-level/AS-level/Scottish Higher Biology within seven years of entry, with minimum grades AB or AA with AS-level Biology.
graduate_policy.masters_or_phd_compensation: A 2.1 degree older than seven years plus a Masters or PhD in a relevant field obtained within seven years may compensate for not having Higher/A-level Chemistry and Biology.
graduate_policy.ucat: Graduate applicants must complete the UCAT and may be invited for interview.
graduate_policy.notes: Stored as eligibility policy. No separate graduate-entry course or separate graduate scoring model is evidenced.

post_16.notes: Official evidence confirms core A-level, SQA, IB and graduate routes. Non-standard qualifications remain unknown.

ucat.notes: All applicants must complete UCAT by the deadline in the same year as application. Applicants who have not sat UCAT will not be considered; no exceptions are made. Current-cycle thresholds are unknown until after UCAT results and are not published until the cycle is complete.

sjt.notes: Official Glasgow evidence states the SJT portion of UCAT is not considered. Band 4 is not stored as an exclusion.

conditions: Required grades and subjects must be obtained at one sitting and at first attempt.
If an applicant has taken longer than the standard period because of extenuating circumstances, an explanation and supporting documentation should be submitted at least six weeks before application.
UCAT scores cannot be adjusted or discounted for extenuating circumstances.
resits.notes: Official evidence states re-sits or additional time to sit qualifications is not permitted for the main academic requirements.

accepted_tests.notes: TOEFL MyBest Score is not accepted.

english_language.notes: Tests must be taken within 2 years 5 months of the programme start date and all overall/component requirements must be met in one test. School-qualification alternatives and exemptions are documented by Glasgow.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: A satisfactory Enhanced Disclosure/PVG certificate and health checks are required before enrolment; UK-domiciled applicants use the Protection of Vulnerable Groups Scheme administered by Disclosure Scotland.

work_experience.policy: Hospital or general-practice work experience is not required, but applicants are expected to have explored the realities of a medical career.

non_academic.notes: The personal statement and reference are reviewed but are not scored, weighted or used to rank applicants for interview. Whether review alone can trigger rejection remains unknown. Work experience in a hospital or general practice is not required.

academic_scoring.notes: Applicants meeting academic eligibility proceed to UCAT cognitive ranking; no competitive academic points are applied. Statement and reference review is unscored and not a ranking factor.

historical_guidance.notes: Historical international interview guidance only. Glasgow has no pre-published fixed UCAT threshold.

ranking_factors.notes: Applicants meeting academic eligibility are ranked for interview by UCAT cognitive score only. Glasgow does not publish a fixed 2027 threshold in advance.

score_components.notes: UCAT ranking is official. Exact current-cycle threshold by applicant group is not known until the cycle progresses and must not be inferred from historical data.

total_score.notes: No points formula is published. This supports eligibility and UCAT ranking metadata only, not deterministic interview prediction.

calculation.notes: Academic and non-academic screening occurs before UCAT ranking. Academics are stored as eligibility/screening only because no competitive academic scoring model is confirmed.

thresholds.notes: Glasgow states 2027 thresholds will not be known until November 2026 and will not be published until the cycle is complete in September 2027. Do not encode a fixed cutoff.

Eligible Scottish-domiciled contextual applicants are ranked in a separate contextual group using their unchanged raw UCAT score. A lower contextual threshold applies, but the live threshold is unknown.

selection_adjustments.notes: This is a separate-pool threshold mechanism, not a UCAT score uplift.

interview_format.timing: Late November 2026 to March 2027 unless otherwise stated.
interview_format.notes: The same two interviewers cover both panels. This is not an MMI. The interview is conversational, with no writing required; interviewers know only the applicant's name.

output_band_policy.basis: Official UCAT-only ranking combined with applicant-group historical thresholds and clearly labelled confidence bands.
output_band_policy.notes: Bands are guidance, not current-cycle cutoff results or probability percentages. A live annual cutoff is not required.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Primary selection model is UCAT ranking after screening. SJT is not considered. Current-cycle thresholds may differ by applicant group and are unknown.

criteria.description: Live in SIMD decile 1-4 (MD20/40) Scottish postcode area.
Estranged from family and living without family support.
Seeking asylum in the UK or has refugee status.
Attend a Western Isles school for Medicine or Veterinary Medicine Reach eligibility.

adjustments.policy_description: For Medicine, adjusted Scottish entry requirement is AAABB or AAAAC Higher in S5 plus BC Advanced Higher in S6, with C not in Chemistry, and successful completion of Reach.

effect.value: AAABB or AAAAC Higher S5 plus BC Advanced Higher S6

adjustments.notes: Stored as official contextual academic eligibility rule.

adjustments.policy_description: Eligible Scottish-domiciled contextual applicants are placed in a separate contextual shortlisting group and ranked by unchanged raw UCAT score against a lower contextual threshold.
adjustments.notes: Contextual UCAT shortlisting applies only to eligible Scottish-domiciled applicants. Historical contextual thresholds, if supplied, must remain separate from policy.

contextual_admissions.notes: Contextual UCAT shortlisting applies only to eligible Scottish-domiciled applicants. Raw UCAT is not uplifted: applicants are ranked in a separate contextual group against a lower threshold. This does not guarantee an interview.

ranking_pools.name: Scotland/Home UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: Future threshold and capacity are unknown. Historical data is context only.

ranking_pools.name: Scottish contextual UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: Separate contextual shortlisting group with a lower dynamic threshold. Raw UCAT is unchanged; current and historical numeric contextual thresholds are not inferred.

ranking_pools.name: Rest of UK UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: Future threshold and capacity are unknown. Historical data is context only.

ranking_pools.name: International UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: International applicants are ranked separately and compete only with other international applicants. Future threshold and capacity are unknown; historical data is guidance only, not a fixed cutoff.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.

quotas.name: Future fixed capacity by applicant pool
quotas.notes: Applicant groups are evidenced, but fixed future quotas/capacity by Scottish, RUK and International groups are not stored in official evidence.

interview_scoring.notes: Interview scores are scaled annually to the cohort. FOI ranges are historical estimates only; the exact rubric, maximum, scaling calculation and fixed pass mark are not publicly released.

ranking_factors.notes: Final decisions are made solely on interview performance. Exact score scale, rubric and ranking conversion are unknown.

waiting_list_policy.policy: A ranked reserve list is activated when offers are declined or places otherwise become available.

standard_offer.notes: Academic entry requirements are stored under Stage 1 by qualification route.

contextual_offer.notes: Medicine adjusted Scottish entry requirement for eligible applicants; successful completion of Reach required.

offer_selection.notes: Final decisions are based solely on annually scaled interview performance within separate applicant pools. UCAT and academic scores do not carry forward and no applicant-group score adjustment is applied after interview. Exact numerical scoring and the complete tie-break sequence remain undisclosed.

historical_admissions.data_scope: Official MBChB admissions data for 2022-2025, including applications, interviews, offers, intake and historical interview thresholds by applicant pool.

cycles.notes: Official historical data for new entrants to Year 1 MBChB. Historical UCAT value is the lowest score considered for interview and must not be used as a 2027 cutoff.
Official historical data for new entrants to Year 1 MBChB. Historical UCAT value is the lowest score considered for interview and must not be used as a 2027 cutoff.
Verified 2024/25 international lowest-invited score on the legacy and current scales. Historical guidance only; it must not be used as a fixed or 2027 cutoff.
Official published total admissions data for new entrants to Year 1 MBChB.
Verified 2023/24 international lowest-invited score. Historical guidance only; not a fixed cutoff.
Verified 2022/23 international lowest-invited score. Historical guidance only; not a fixed cutoff.
Verified 2021/22 international lowest-invited score. Historical guidance only; not a fixed cutoff.

international_ucat_guidance_2700.notes: Historical invited-score guidance only. Glasgow sets the international threshold after receiving each cycle's UCAT scores and has no pre-published fixed threshold.

contextual_historical_interview_threshol.notes: Contextual policy is stored separately. No numeric historical contextual thresholds were supplied, so none are inferred.

historical_admissions.notes: Historical admissions, interview thresholds and converted offer-holder UCAT statistics are context only. They are not deterministic, not current-cycle cutoffs and not an official prediction model.
